sources.entry: Betula - Single-user federated bookmark manager with Fediverse support and archives. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Go

summary.name: Betula
summary.one_liner: Betula is a free, self-hosted, single-user federated bookmark manager with archiving support for keeping a linklog or personal web archive.
use_cases: Publish a linklog of shared links
Keep archived copies of web pages
Share public bookmarks with Fediverse followers
Migrate bookmarks from Pinboard, Raindrop or browsers
summary.what_it_does: Betula lets you save bookmarks with a title, optional description (formatted with Mycomarkup), and tags, and mark each as public or private. Public bookmarks can be followed from Mastodon, Akkoma, Smithereen and similar Fediverse software, and you can subscribe to other Betula servers. It can keep archive copies of web pages and produces IndieWeb microformats. Import and export cover Netscape Bookmark File, Pinboard JSON and Raindrop CSV formats.
notable: Installs as one binary with all configuration done through the web interface and a single SQLite collection file
Fediverse federation: followers receive new public bookmarks, and users can follow other Betula instances
Calm UI that works without JavaScript
caveats: Only the latest version is supported; older releases are unsupported
Packages are maintained by third parties, not the Betula developers
Platform list is inferred from the page's mention of packages, pre-built binaries and containers; OS names are not explicitly listed on the page
